title: Quantum M2-branes and Holography
summary: We discuss the semi-classical quantisation of supersymmetric membranes in holographic geometries with asymptotic AdS$_4$ and AdS$_7$ boundary conditions. In AdS$_4$ geometries this quantisation prompts the need of ensemble changes when comparing bulk and boundary observables arising from such membranes. We also discuss how supersymmetric membranes localise to loci where the background Killing spinor turns chiral, circumventing the need of evaluating their zero-mode moduli integrals.
